kind: inference/retrieval service and editor coding assistant

runtime.execution: Rust Tokio/Axum inference/answer service with Arc trait backends and DB; TypeScript language-server/editor client produces previews under single edit mutex.
runtime.service_boundary: Server owns inference/retrieval/thread storage and supplies compatible APIs; editor agent consumes it and delegates actual workspace mutations to editor. Pochi link is separate agent, not engine hidden in these paths.

summary: Tabby is primarily a reusable inference/retrieval/answer service plus editor completion and preview-edit assistant. Its client named agent does not establish an autonomous model-native shell/tool continuation loop.

inspection.scope: Selected source excerpts trace exposed entry/loop/request/action/result/state boundaries and relevant capability mechanisms; listed tests are read as source only.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed, dependencies installed or live providers invoked. Claims concern this pinned snapshot; untraced catalog tools and dependency internals are not inferred.

actions.name: serve / download
actions.input: configured models/device/server arguments or model ID
actions.output: running inference/answer service or downloaded model
actions.lifecycle: Tokio process; startup config load; download internals untraced

actions.name: POST /v1/chat/completions / /v1beta/chat/completions
actions.lifecycle: forwards to configured backend; connection stream lifecycle, no execution-loop settlement
actions.authority: authorized client/user headers; model no OS tool authority

actions.name: AnswerService.answer / ThreadService.create_run
actions.lifecycle: fixed retrieval/related-question/final-answer pipeline; persists selected state as it streams
actions.authority: user source access policy; service performs predetermined retrieval

actions.name: tabby/chat/edit
actions.output: edit token + preview stream or feature/length/mutex error
actions.lifecycle: one current edit under global mutex, selected-context template provider request

actions.name: tabby/chat/edit/resolve
actions.lifecycle: reconstructs desired preview lines then applies via host editor

actions.name: tabby/chat/smartApply
actions.lifecycle: range heuristic then possible LLM fallback and edit stream under mutex

actions.name: fetchFileContent / ReadFileRequest
actions.lifecycle: reads context before edit; does not expose general model filesystem tool

actions.name: ConfigFile.watch / updated
actions.lifecycle: reload on file add/change; active edit already captured config

actions.name: DbConn.create_thread / list_threads / message updates
actions.lifecycle: durable mutable application records; no general model SQL channel

filesystem.detail: Editor context reads synced/delegated/local files and accepted previews use host WorkspaceEdit; no arbitrary model read/write tool in answer route.

processes.detail: Inspected inference/answer/editor service supplies no model command-execution lifecycle; local server inference infrastructure is not agent shell authority.

code_actions.detail: Editor tabby/chat/edit and smartApply generate a preview/token then accept/discard WorkspaceEdit. These are proposed code edits; model-authored executable programs composing native tools are not established by inspected edit/completion/answer paths.

persistent_kernel.detail: Reference inference service/editor assistant has no inspected execution-kernel consumer contract; model inference process is not operator language kernel.

standing_database.detail: Server persists thread/message/attachment state through DB operations and authorized retrieval context. Internal application storage is not model general database execution.

workflow_programming.detail: REST/LSP and trait backend API enable host composition; editor template/preset context plus fixed answer pipeline. Model-authored workflow/turn program not established.

multi_model.detail: Configured inference model default/support fallback and answer model_name selection are actual routing; no independent agents or mixed-model conversation authority established.

live_collaboration.detail: Thread sharing/application users and separate Pochi link do not establish live agent-to-agent collaboration; inspected component role is inference/retrieval/editor assistance.

concurrent_work.detail: Tokio/Axum service supplies independent request streams and joined document enrichment; editor edits explicitly global-mutex serialized. No multi-agent work scheduler established.

steering_interrupt.detail: Editor cancellation/stop/cancel maps to request abort; no ongoing model-task steering/queue or all owned inference process quiescence contract traced.

turn_redefinition.detail: Fixed answer-request/retrieval and one-shot editor edit paths are service contracts, not an exposed autonomous agent turn scheduler.

compaction.detail: No semantic context compaction/projection mechanism established in inspected answer request construction/thread persistence/editor template paths.

context_repair.detail: Persistent thread data and editor reread context support host reconstruction, but no native model original-context fetch/repair protocol established.

original_audit.detail: Thread deltas persist into mutable content/attachments; coarse completion logger records operation event, not original prompts/chunks/tool/OS effects. Edits/debug templates may log locally but no complete immutable audit.

audit_query.detail: DB thread listing/message records are queryable application state; not immutable originals or complete event history.

hot_change.detail: Client config file data refresh and health-based feature registration are wired; server main startup loads config once. No compiled executable handoff or affected-workflow fence established.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Server/editor client lacks inspected agent continuity/refit lifecycle; API clients could compose continuity externally but it is not supplied here.

remote_services.detail: Compatible service API and remote provider backend trait with reusable Arc inference/retrieval components suit an externally consumed service role. Editor host owns workspace mutation.

self_improvement.detail: No self-directed coding-agent improvement loop in inspected service/editor role; standalone Pochi is a different reference.

complaints.detail: No native model grievance filing or independently tracked state bundle established in inspected API/editor/thread paths.

authority.detail: User policy filters repository/doc retrieval sources; editor host accepts/discards changes and uses synced/delegated files. No provider model command authority inferred.

evaluation.detail: Fake answer/retrieval test only asserts stream count; local model/SSE goldens snapshot seeded text. Neither proves edit correctness, complete audit or broad agent behavior; not run.

time_order.detail: Thread IDs/create/update timestamps and per-stream persist-before-yield order provide application sequencing, not global effect/audit causal order.

evidence.claim: Tabby describes self-hosted coding assistant; Pochi task agent is linked separately, not this service engine.
Rust Tokio main loads config once, prepares owned root and dispatches serve/download CLI.
Axum mounts configured completion and chat SSE endpoints; absent completion has explicit NOT_IMPLEMENTED route.
Chat endpoint forwards request to trait backend, streams chunks and logs coarse ChatCompletion event; no native tool execution/continuation in this route.
Configured remote model processing fills default or falls back unsupported models and adapts provider-specific fields.
Backend ChatCompletionStream invokes configured compatible/Azure chat create/create_stream; provider selection is not peer collaboration.
Answer stream reads authorized context, fixed pipeline decides code needs, lists capped files and retrieves snippets.
Answer pipeline filters authorized doc sources, concurrently enriches attachments, optionally asks related questions and constructs final chat request with model selection.
Answer emits content deltas from one final chat stream and logs coarse completion event; no arbitrary tool-call loop traced.
Thread create_run loads messages, requires last user, creates assistant message ID before answer and emits paired identities.
Stream persists delta text and overwrites selected attachments/relevant questions before yielding each item.
Persistent thread messages have content/attachments/timestamps and DB list/create operations with user filtering.
Attachment updates overwrite current JSON data and updated_at; mutable application data, not immutable original event history.
Editor chat capability dynamically registers/unregisters when server health exposes chat model.
Language-server host constructs/registers chat edit, smart apply and command/completion features.
LSP requests wire edit command listing, edit creation and edit resolution.
Context file read uses synced documents, delegated workspace read or local filesystem fallback.
Inline edit requires preview format/synced document and available chat; document length limit and global edit mutex, cancellation requests abort.
Template composes context into one chat request, passes mutex abort signal, returns edit token and supports current-edit stop/cancel.
Accept/discard resolution reconstructs preview text and applies WorkspaceEdit through editor host.
SmartApply exposes separate request, computes range or asks LLM fallback then edit generation under same mutex/abort.
Native protocol edit request name is tabby/chat/edit and returns ChatEditToken.
Native tabby/chat/edit/resolve supports accept/discard/cancel at preview location.
Native SmartApply protocol name tabby/chat/smartApply returns bool or typed feature/document/mutex errors.
Client config file watcher reloads data and emits update on changed content; no deferred workflow fence.
Answer test uses fake chat/code/doc/context/auth and in-memory DB, asserting six streamed items.
Golden harness would launch real local Tabby inference server/model with kill-on-drop process.
Golden oracle collects SSE text then snapshot asserts, not coding correctness or full audit.
Seeded Metal platform golden examples request generic Python/regex answers; tests not executed.

tests.oracle: Fake auth/chat/code/doc/context and in-memory DB assert six stream events; no live semantic retrieval/edit oracle.
Would spawn local model/server and compare collected seeded text; platform-specific and requires inference artifact. Not run; snapshots do not assert coding task success.

strengths: Actual compiled Rust service core, with editor client cleanly consuming API and owning UI/preview choices.
Authorized source retrieval and stored thread attachments expose relevant service/context boundary.
Explicit edit token, cancellation and accept/discard WorkspaceEdit lifecycle.
limits: Not an autonomous coding harness in inspected paths; Pochi tasks are another repository.
Model selection, shareable threads and internal DB must not become multi-agent collaboration or model standing SQL claims.
Global editor edit mutex limits concurrent preview work.
Mutable thread state/coarse completion events lack full original audit.
Client config refresh does not imply server hot compiled refit or active agent continuity.
arconaut_questions: What inference/retrieval APIs should Arconaut consume from independent services, preserving strong systems implementation without becoming their governor?
Keep request tokens and UI preview/edit lifecycle separate from model-native execution/workflow authority.
Retain service request/response provenance in Arconaut audit even when provider/reference stores only mutable thread content.
